name: Walking Knee Hug
steps: Stand tall at the start of an open walkway with your shoulders relaxed and core lightly braced.
Step forward onto one foot, lift your opposite knee high toward your chest, and wrap both hands around your shin.
Pull your knee gently closer to your chest while rising tall onto the ball of your standing foot for a brief stretch.
Release smoothly to step that foot forward and continue alternating legs down the lane for the target duration.
tips: Keep your standing leg straight and chest tall instead of rounding your upper back down to meet your knee.
Pull just below your knee on your shin to avoid putting direct pressure on your kneecap.
